text: Hana Financial Group's governance page lists its shareholders holding 1% or more of the common stock as of 31 March 2026. The largest is Korea's National Pension Service (국민연금공단) with 8.69%, then BlackRock Fund Advisors (7.11%) and Capital Research and Management Company (5.55%); all other listed holders are below 4%.
short: Hana Financial Group's largest holder is South Korea's National Pension Service at 8.69% (31 March 2026).
